69:1: Interpretation of Surah Al-Haqqah In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful Al-Haqqah is one of the names of the Day of Resurrection because the promise and the threat will be fulfilled in it. That is why God made it so great, saying: {And what will make you know what is the Inevitable?} Then God mentioned His destruction of the nations who denied it, saying: {As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the Tyrant}, which is the blast that silenced them and the earthquake that stilled them. This is what Qatadah said: Taghiyah is the blast, and this is the preferred view of Ibn Jarir. Mujahid said: Taghiyah is sins. Ar-Rabi’ ibn Anas and Ibn Zayd also said that it means tyranny. Ibn Zayd recited: Thamud denied it because of their transgression. As-Suddi said: They were destroyed by the Tyrant, meaning the one who hamstrung the she-camel. {As for ‘Aad, they were destroyed by a furious wind}, meaning a cold one. Qatadah, As-Suddi, Ar-Rabi’ ibn Anas and Ath-Thawri said: Atyah means a very strong blowing. Qatadah said: It was violent upon them until it pierced their hearts. Ad-Dahhak said: Sarsar is cold and Atiyah is violent. It attacked them without mercy or blessing. Ali and others said: It attacked the guards and left without being held to account. He subjected it to them means He made it subject to them seven nights and eight days in succession meaning complete, consecutive, and unlucky. Ibn Mas`ud, Ibn `Abbas, Mujahid, `Ikrimah, Ath-Thawri, and others said: seven consecutive, consecutive, and from `Ikrimah and Ar-Rabi` ibn Khathim: unlucky for them as in the saying of God the Almighty: in unlucky days, Ar-Rabi` said: The first of them was Friday, and someone else said: Wednesday. It is said that it is what people call ajaz, and it is as if people took that from the saying of God the Almighty: Then you will see the people therein fallen down as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees, and it is said that it is because it is at the end of winter. It is also called the days of the old woman because an old woman from the people of `Aad entered a flock and the wind killed her on the eighth day. This was narrated by Al-Baghawi, and God knows best. Ibn Abbas said: Empty is ruined. Another said: Destroyed, meaning that the wind would strike one of them to the ground, and he would fall dead on his head. His head would be split open, and his body would remain lifeless, as if it were a palm tree standing upright without branches. It has been proven in the two Sahihs that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: I was aided by the north wind, and the ‘Ad were destroyed by the south wind. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Muhammad ibn Yahya ibn al-Durais al-‘Abdi told us, Ibn Fadil told us, on the authority of Muslim, on the authority of Mujahid, on the authority of Ibn ‘Umar, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “God did not open to the ‘Ad people the wind by which they were destroyed except the place of a ring. It passed over the people of the desert, and carried them and their livestock and their wealth, and made them fall between the sky and the earth. When the people of the urban areas of ‘Ad saw that wind and what was in it, they said, ‘This is a cloud bringing us rain.’ So it rained on the people of the desert and their livestock on the people of the urban areas.” Al-Thawri said, on the authority of Layth, on the authority of Mujahid: The wind has two wings and a tail. Do you see any remnant of them? That is, do you sense any of their remnants or those who are related to them? Rather, they perished, to the last one, and God did not grant them a successor. Then God the Almighty said: And there came Pharaoh and those before him The qaf is read with a kasra, meaning those who were with him from among his followers from the infidel Copts at his time. Others read it with a fatha, meaning those who were before him from the nations who resembled him. And God the Almighty said: And the overturned They are the nations who denied the messengers with the sin which is the denial of what God revealed. Al-Rabi’ said: with the sin meaning with the transgression. Mujahid said: with the sins. That is why God the Almighty said: So they disobeyed the Messenger of their Lord This is a category, meaning every lie that the Messenger of God denied them, as God the Almighty said: Every lie of the messengers, so the threat is justified. And whoever denies a messenger has denied all of them, as God the Almighty said: The people of Noah denied the messengers, “‘Aad denied the messengers,” Thamud denied the messengers. Only one Messenger came to each nation, and that is why He said here: But they disobeyed the Messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a mighty grip meaning a great, severe, and painful one. Mujahid said: a mighty hill. Al-Suddi said: a destructive one. Then God Almighty said: When the water overflowed, meaning it exceeded the limit by God’s permission and rose above existence. Ibn Abbas and others said: The water overflowed and became abundant, and that was because of the supplication of Noah, peace be upon him, against his people when they denied him and disobeyed him, so they worshipped other than God, so God answered him and the flood covered the people of the earth except for those who were with Noah in the ship, so all people are from the lineage of Noah and his descendants. Ibn Jarir said: Ibn Hamid told us, Mihran told us, on the authority of Abu Sinan Saeed bin Sinan, on the authority of more than one person, on the authority of Ali bin Abi Talib, who said: Not a drop of water descended except by measure at the hands of an angel. Then, on the day of Noah, permission was given to the water without the tank, but the water overflowed the tank and came out. That is why the Almighty said: When the water overflowed, meaning it exceeded the limit by God’s permission, We carried you in the moving ship. And nothing of the wind descended except by measure at the hands of an angel, except on the day of Aad, for he gave it permission without the tank, so it came out. That is why the Almighty said, expressing gratitude to the al-Nas 114:When the water overflowed, We carried you in the moving ship, meaning the ship that moves on the surface of the water, that We may make it for you a reminder. The pronoun refers back to the type because the meaning indicates it, meaning, We left for you from its type what you ride on the current of the water in the seas, as He said: And He made for you of the ships and the grazing livestock that you ride on, that you may mount on their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you are mounted on them. God the Almighty said: “And a sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden ship. And created for them from the like thereof that on which they ride.” Qatada said: God kept the ship alive until the first of this nation lived to see it. The former is more evident, and for this reason God the Almighty said: And a hearing ear will receive it, meaning, a hearing ear will understand and remember this blessing. Ibn Abbas said: Memorizing and hearing. Qatada said: A hearing ear understands from God and benefits from what it hears from the Book of God. Ad-Dahhak said: And a hearing ear will receive it, meaning, an ear heard it and understood, meaning, one who has sound hearing and a sound mind. This is general and includes everyone who understands and understands. Ibn Abi Hatim said: Abu Zur’ah al-Dimashqi told us, al-Abbas ibn al-Walid ibn Subaih al-Dimashqi told us, Zaid ibn Yahya told us, Ali ibn Hawshab told us: I heard Makhul say: When the verse and a hearing ear will receive it was revealed to the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: I asked my Lord to make it the ear of Ali. Makhul said: Ali used to say: I never heard anything from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, that I forgot. And this is how Ibn Jarir narrated it on the authority of Ali ibn Sahl on the authority of al-Walid ibn Muslim on the authority of Ali ibn Hawshab on the authority of Makhul, and it is a mursal hadith. Ibn Abi Hatim also said: Ja`far ibn Muhammad ibn `Aamer told us, Bishr ibn Adam told us, `Abdullah ibn al-Zubayr Abu Muhammad, meaning the father of Abu Ahmad al-Zubayr, told us, Salih ibn al-Haitham told me: I heard Buraydah al-Aslami say: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to `Ali, I have been commanded to bring you close and not to drive you away, and to teach you and to understand, and it is your right to understand. He said: Then this verse was revealed: And a listening ear will receive it. Ibn Jarir narrated it on the authority of Muhammad ibn Khalaf on the authority of Bishr ibn Adam with this chain of transmission. Then Ibn Jarir narrated it through another chain of transmission on the authority of Abu Dawud al-A`ma on the authority of Buraydah with this chain of transmission, and it is also not authentic.
